about.text: A strong, smoky soft cheese with an orange rind, from Pornic in Loire-Atlantique, made from raw cow's milk from six farms. The curd is set with rennet and lactic cultures, moulded and brined, then aged 4 to 8 weeks on spruce boards, washed with salted water and Brevibacterium linens.

sources.text: The process, origin and ownership, from the article on the cheese.
